changed_ids.change: Rewrote working_assumption and reconciliation fields. Removed language implying Wonderland reuses a real neighbouring country house's party/staff (estate grounding, rejected by ruling 5.2 A) and implying broad/full character doubling (rejected by ruling 5.3 B, which selects light doubling only). New text: Wonderland is dream-only space per SUP-001/5.2 A, waking world stays small (bank, field, rabbit-hole entrance, family house a short run away, farm within earshot); only a light set of named echoes double waking-world people (housemaid→Mary Ann, Dinah→Cheshire Cat, sister glimpsed at the trial), per 5.3 B. reconciliation field changed from 'PARTLY CONSISTENT ... Decision needed at H1' to 'RESOLVED at H1 pre-ruling' with an explicit citation of the ruling file and both ruling letters (5.2 A, 5.3 B).

Rewrote summary, visual and sound to the softened staging required by ruling 5.4 B: the canvas sack goes over the guinea-pig juror's head and shoulders only, officers hustle the juror straight out of court, nobody sits on them. source.quote kept verbatim (the book's own text, 'sat upon it', is retained for citation per source_refs_required and is now explicitly framed in the summary as the source's staging that this production softens). Flipped inferred from false to true and added a reason explaining the softened on-screen staging is a designed production choice under SUP-014's custody-as-huddle rule and the H1 ruling, distinct from the sourced book text. Removed the stale 'h1_pending': 'DEF-p2-bible-006' marker since the defect is now fixed.

Minor wording clarification only (summary): 'the county gentry's social calendar' reworded to 'the Queen's court's social calendar' with an explicit parenthetical '(a dream-only occasion per ruling 5.2 A, not a real neighbouring estate's event)' to remove any ambiguity that this doubles a real waking-world estate. No change to practiced_by, source, visual, sound, or inferred status.

Minor wording clarification only (summary, final sentence): 'This is the county-gentry social season's centrepiece occasion in this world' reworded to 'This is the dream's own social-season centrepiece occasion, invented entirely within Wonderland (ruling 5.2 A) rather than doubling a real neighbouring estate's garden party.' No change to practiced_by, source, visual, sound, or inferred status.
